results.title: Checkpoint rows accumulate and none is ever retired
results.evidence: twelve verifications wrote 12 checkpoint row(s) (0 → 12) and nothing in `EvidenceEngine` removes one. Only `first('seq', desc=True)` is ever read, so every row but the newest is dead weight that grows at the scheduled cadence for the life of the deployment — on a register whose stated position is that nothing is deleted, in a table that is not the evidence chain and carries no evidentiary value
